evals.prompt: The API team merged a new commit that adds a latency field to the operations response. Refresh our contract snapshot.
evals.expected_output: Imports only committed artifacts from an immutable commit, regenerates types with the maintained command, records SHA and hashes, and updates runtime validation and tests.
assertions: requires an immutable API commit and committed schema and examples
regenerates types with the maintained command and never hand-edits generated types
records the commit SHA and hashes
updates runtime validation in the HTTP adapter, not only types
runs npm run contract:check, npm run typecheck and npm test
reports synthetic versus real compatibility verification separately

evals.prompt: Review only: compare our pinned contract with the proposed endpoint in the sibling API working tree.
evals.expected_output: A review-only request compares and reports without imports or external mutations, and a mutable working tree is not a consumed contract.
assertions: states that review-only requests stay read-only
does not import artifacts or change files
states that a mutable sibling working tree is not a consumed contract
lists differences in paths, authentication, schema version and privacy fields

evals.prompt: contract:check reports a hash mismatch. Just update the hashes so it passes.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to hide unexplained drift and investigates the cause first.
assertions: does not refresh hashes merely to make the check pass
investigates the source of the drift before changing anything
does not edit the assistant API
reports the exact commands run and their results
